decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system remains visible two years after launch and fits the firm's specialist, standards-driven marine portfolio, so the option still appears valuable enough to retain.
The spring-balanced desk lamp disappeared from the website by 2024, suggesting weak traction or low strategic fit, so real-options logic favors abandoning it rather than committing further resources.
The general interior lighting luminaire stayed on the website into 2024 and sits close to the firm's core building-lighting business, making it a low-risk option to continue.
The pendant luminaire was still being highlighted as a recent release in 2024, which indicates continuing commercial promise and justifies keeping the option open.

The marine searchlight remained in the portfolio while a related marine HMI searchlight disappeared, implying the firm has already screened the category and sees enough value in this version to continue.
